newsitem.title: INDIA: Citibank syndicates $18 mln for India Hindalco.
newsitem.headline: Citibank syndicates $18 mln for India Hindalco.

text.p: Citibank International Plc said on Thursday it had arranged a syndicated $18 million foreign currency loan at 40 basis points over LIBOR for India's Hindalco Industries Ltd.

"The loan is structured at 40 basis points above LIBOR with an average tenor of three years and door-to-door facility of four years," Citibank said in a statement. "The offering was oversubscribed but not increased," it added.
The loan was arranged to finance rupee capital expenditure up to $15 million and to augment long-term working capital resources by $3 million, the statement said.

Banks joining the facility include Sumitomo Bank Ltd, Banca Monte Die Paschi Di Siena SpA, Banque Francaise Du Commerce Exterieur, Fuji Bank Ltd, the National Bank of Abu Dhabi, Citibank NA and SBI European Bank plc, the statement said.
